title: 2000 Red Amaranth spinach Bayam seeds (fr SG)
description:
2000 Red Amaranth spinach Bayam seeds (fr SG)

Spinach is a leafy green flowering plant native to central and western Asia. Spinach has similar growing conditions and requirements as lettuce. Best grown in cool weather. It is higher in iron, calcium, and vitamins than most cultivated greens, and one of the best sources of vitamins A, B, and C.

Type of vegetable: Leafy
Edible parts: Leaves

DIRECTION OF USE
Best soil: Fertile, well-drained loose soil
How to plant: When seedlings sprout to about two inches, thin them to 3-4 inches apart.
How to harvest: Treat plants as a ‘cut-and-come-again’ crop. Spinach leaves can be harvested as soon as they are big enough to eat.
Light: Full sunlight
Care: Water regularly. Keep soil moist with mulching. Fertilise when only necessary.

STORAGE
Keep away from children and pets.
Store in cool and dry place away from direct sunlight.

Spinach is a leafy green flowering plant native to central and western Asia. Spinach has similar growing conditions and requirements as lettuce. Best grown in cool weather. It is higher in iron, calcium, and vitamins than most cultivated greens, and one of the best sources of vitamins A, B, and C.

Type of vegetable: Leafy
Edible parts: Leaves

DIRECTION OF USE
Best soil: Fertile, well-drained loose soil
How to plant: When seedlings sprout to about two inches, thin them to 3-4 inches apart.
How to harvest: Treat plants as a ‘cut-and-come-again’ crop. Spinach leaves can be harvested as soon as they are big enough to eat.
Light: Full sunlight
Care: Water regularly. Keep soil moist with mulching. Fertilise when only necessary.

STORAGE
Keep away from children and pets.
Store in cool and dry place away from direct sunlight.
